title: tcp_connection_throttle plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `tcp_connection_throttle` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component TcpConnectionThrottleConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

TcpConnectionThrottleConfig.description: Plugin: tcp_connection_throttle — Caps active TCP/TCP+TLS connections per Consumer when a stream auth plugin identified one, else per canonical client IP. Explicit proxy/proxy-group attachment to any other protocol is rejected during configuration admission and plugin-cache validation. A global policy with a nonempty effective target set must cover at least one TCP/TCP+TLS proxy; mixed global scope is filtered from unsupported listeners. UDP/DTLS is not protected; use udp_rate_limiting for datagram/session admission. Enforcement is process-local, so each replica independently permits up to the configured limit and the deployment-wide allowance can be the limit multiplied by the number of replicas receiving the same identity. A counter entry is removed inline by the permit release that takes it to zero, so there is no background sweep. IP keys use the canonical client IP: IPv4 (including IPv4-mapped IPv6) is keyed per address, while native IPv6 sources are grouped to ipv6_prefix (default /64), so hosts in one /64 share a budget unless it is raised to 128. For IP keys the gateway-wide accept-time bound FERRUM_TCP_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP (default 256, counted across every TCP stream listener and grouped by FERRUM_PER_IP_IPV6_PREFIX) applies first and closes over-cap connections before this plugin runs, so a max_connections_per_key above that bound can never bind; this plugin can only tighten it. Refusals are counted per proxy in the Prometheus counter ferrum_tcp_connection_throttle_rejections_total.

max_connections_per_key.description: Maximum active TCP connections allowed for one Consumer/IP key in this ferrum-edge process. Each replica enforces this limit independently. For IP keys the effective limit is also bounded by FERRUM_TCP_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP (default 256), which is enforced at accept time before this plugin runs.

ipv6_prefix.description: Prefix length used to group native IPv6 client addresses into one IP key. The default 64 makes every host in one /64 share a budget; 128 keys each IPv6 address separately. IPv4 and IPv4-mapped IPv6 clients are always keyed per address, and Consumer keys are unaffected. Independent of FERRUM_PER_IP_IPV6_PREFIX, which only groups the gateway-wide FERRUM_*_PER_IP caps.
